claims: Full logarithmically weighted strain-gradient estimate, including amplitude and within-sign derivatives, on the same smooth unforced periodic NS solution.
Frobenius normalized-shape entropy with the complete zero-set measure; weighted parabolic-operator estimates for the full shape and both isolated eigenlines.
The fixed-axis cone estimate extends to a double cone; the geometric complement and cutoff errors remain.
Spectral amplitude-layer measures retain all threshold contributions and average to the smooth entropy.
Huber tests recover a classical-strength weak L4/3 second-derivative estimate; actual direct interpolation still misses the critical time exponent.
limitations: No new unconditional critical estimate, general-data regularity, singular solution, novelty certification, human peer review or Clay solution.
Weighted LB and LP are not temporal or material BV estimates, and their open-set equations are not extended across zero sets.
Amplitude-layer tail convergence has no adequate critical rate; the geometric-complement L4 time norm remains unproved.
Even removing only the logarithmic gradient loss does not cross the displayed direct-interpolation gap.
The Vasseur-Yang source is used for scoped literature comparison, not a periodic weak-solution theorem transplant.
No public overview, website/local reader, attachment, result count or recap update is requested.
